body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes a production-only blank page regression in the Console build (Vercel) by replacing the Rollup `external: ['crypto']` workaround with a Vite-time stub, and adds Playwright E2E coverage that runs against the production `vite preview` artifact.

**Changes:**
- Added a `viteCryptoStub()` plugin to stub `crypto` for browser builds and applied it to Console + msw-todo example Vite configs.
- Switched Playwright to run E2E against the Console production build served by `vite preview` on port 4173.
- Added new Playwright E2E specs/helpers and integrated an `e2e` job into CI.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| scripts/vite-crypto-stub.ts | Introduces a Vite plugin that resolves `crypto` to a browser-safe stub to prevent bare specifier imports in production bundles. |
| apps/console/vite.config.ts | Uses the new `viteCryptoStub()` plugin and removes the Rollup `external: ['crypto']` workaround. |
| examples/msw-todo/vite.config.ts | Uses the new `viteCryptoStub()` plugin and removes the Rollup `external: ['crypto']` workaround. |
| playwright.config.ts | Runs Playwright against `vite preview` (port 4173) and builds the Console before serving. |
| e2e/helpers/index.ts | Adds shared helper to wait for React to mount in `#root`. |
| e2e/smoke.spec.ts | Expands smoke coverage to detect blank-page regressions and missing critical assets in production preview. |
| e2e/console-rendering.spec.ts | Adds bootstrap/SPA-fallback/MSW presence checks for the Console production build. |
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | Adds a dedicated `e2e` CI job running Chromium Playwright tests and uploading reports. |
</details>

`webServer.command` passes `--port 4173` directly after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console preview`, which may be parsed by pnpm instead of being forwarded to the `vite preview` script. To ensure the port flag reaches Vite reliably, use `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run preview -- --port 4173` (or equivalent `--` separator) in the command string.
```suggestion
    command: 'pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run preview -- --port 4173',
```

The step name says the Playwright report is uploaded "on failure", but the condition `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` uploads it for successful runs too. If the intent is failure-only uploads, switch this to `if: ${{ failure() && !cancelled() }}` (or `failure()` alone).
